name: newfocus_landing
description: Responsive landing page for New Focus, a wellness and productivity app for building healthy habits, routines and daily planning.

paragraphs: Responsive landing page for New Focus, a wellness and productivity app that helps people build healthy habits and plan their day.

New Focus is built around one idea: improving people's quality of life with tools and resources that help them balance their physical, mental and emotional health while staying productive. This repository contains the source code of its landing page, which introduces the product, its mission and its promotional material.
features: Responsive layout that adapts to different devices and screen sizes through a dedicated responsive stylesheet.
Interactive elements such as a dropdown navigation and a content slider, written in vanilla JavaScript.
Smooth, animated interface designed to keep the experience pleasant and easy to follow.
Theming with CSS custom properties, keeping colors and shared values in a single file.
Zero dependencies: plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript, no build step required.
